question.text: The NSE CM auto pay-in/reporting facility, where securities for pay-in are reported using early pay-in, Auto DO, and CM settlement pocket quantities, is available on:

explanation.text: The Logic: The NSE CM auto pay-in/reporting facility is available to NSE clearing members on written request to the CC (NSCCL). The facility reports pay-in using early pay-in, Auto DO, and CM settlement pocket quantities. The Trap: 'Automatic' is wrong — CMs must specifically request this facility in writing from NSCCL. Note: The facility is opt-in and operates through the written-request route, not by default activation.
